n = int(input())
s = list(input())
beauty = list(map(int, input().split()))
totalBeauty = sum(beauty)

equalPairs = []
charOccurrencesInEqualPairs = [0] * 128
mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = 'a'

for i in range(n // 2):
    if s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]:
        equalPairs.append(i)
        char_code = ord(s[i])
        charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[char_code] += 1
        if charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[char_code] > charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[ord(mostCommonCharInEqualPairs)]:
            mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = s[i]

ans = totalBeauty
for equalPair in equalPairs:
    ans -= min(beauty[equalPair], beauty[n - 1 - equalPair])

if charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[ord(mostCommonCharInEqualPairs)] > len(equalPairs) / 2:
    nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties = []
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if s[i] != s[n - 1 - i] and s[i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs and s[n - 1 - i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs:
            nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.append(min(beauty[i], beauty[n - 1 - i]))
    nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.sort()
    rem = 2 * charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[ord(mostCommonCharInEqualPairs)] - len(equalPairs)
    for i in range(rem):
        ans -= nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties[i]

print(ans)
